content.text: You’ve spent months designing fonts, templates, or presets. Your work is ready. But when you try to sell it, Stripe rejects your application. PayPal blocks your account. Conventional payment gateways lock you out. This is not a failure of effort—it’s a failure of infrastructure. COREMERCH solves this by deploying sovereign commerce stacks that let you sell digital products directly to buyers in Kenya and beyond, using crypto payments that settle in minutes. No platforms. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. Own the infrastructure. Control the revenue. This is how.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. COREMERCH designs and deploys digital commerce stacks that give you full ownership of your sales process. The stack combines free and paid tools into a unified system: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders, and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. The system is automated, secure, and yours to own. No platform can shut you down. No currency collapse can stop you. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who need to sell design assets without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any third party.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it works: A buyer visits your storefront, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select a product—a font, template, or preset—and pay using NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain in real time. Once confirmed, a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script triggers file delivery from Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. The order is logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. The entire process is automated, with no manual intervention required. The stack is modular: you can swap components as needed. For example, use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. You own every piece of the system. COREMERCH deploys it for you, then steps away. No ongoing access. No hidden dependencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in Kenya and similar regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, fonts, templates, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this stack gives you a fully operational online store. It’s for creators who value ownership over convenience, sovereignty over workarounds. The system is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s not a solution for those who want to rent infrastructure—it’s for those who want to own it. If you’re tired of being locked out, this is your exit. Deploy once, own forever. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. Just sovereign commerce.
Own your infrastructure—no platforms, no gatekeepers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally fast. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate file delivery and order logging. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your needs. Files are delivered via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, ensuring instant access for buyers. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. Together, they form a seamless system that requires no technical expertise to operate. COREMERCH handles deployment, so you can focus on creating and selling.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to deploy? Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all six blueprints, seven templates, and instant access to the source code. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both are deployed within 48 hours, with products loaded and tested. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation if you want to build it yourself. Each option gives you lifetime access to the infrastructure. No recurring fees. No platform lock-in. Once deployed, the system is yours to operate, scale, and modify. This is not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Sell your design assets with confidence, knowing the infrastructure is yours.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), Edge Commerce Stack ($197), or Complete Builder Kit ($197). 2. Provide product details and payment preferences to COREMERCH for deployment. 3. Receive your deployed stack within 48 hours, with products loaded and tested. 4. Test the system end-to-end to ensure file delivery and payment processing work seamlessly. 5. Promote your storefront and start selling design assets globally. 6. Monitor orders via Supabase or Google Sheets and scale as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. COREMERCH handles deployment, and the system is designed for non-technical users. You only need to manage your storefront and products.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. Once deployed, the stack is yours to own and operate. There are no subscriptions or hidden fees.
Can I modify the stack after deployment?
Yes. You own the infrastructure and can modify it as needed. COREMERCH has no access after delivery.
How secure is the payment process?
NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain in real time. The system is automated and secure, with no manual intervention required.
